Ava (FinOps): Anyone else see a double bill on the Dec invoice?
Ava (FinOps): There's an odd line item called INTERLEAVED_RESERVED_ADJ for GPUs — it's almost exactly the same amount as our reserved capacity line.
Diego (Infra): Huh. Do you have the invoice line and billing export rows?
Ava (FinOps): Pasted the two CSV rows I exported from our billing export below: 
```csv
invoice_id,sku,description,region,amount_usd,usage_start,usage_end
INV-2024-12,COMPUTE-GPU-RESERVED,Reserved GPU Hours,us-west1,12000,2024-12-01,2024-12-31
INV-2024-12,INTERLEAVED_RESERVED_ADJ,Interleaved reserved capacity adjustment,us-west1,11980,2024-12-01,2024-12-31
```
Ava (FinOps): Note the amounts and date ranges are identical-ish.
Maya (CloudOps): INTERLEAVED_RESERVED_ADJ is not a label we create. Sounds like a provider-side adjustment. Which cloud account?
Ava (FinOps): Project/redwood-prod-usw, billing account BA-9876 (GCP).
Sam (EngOps): Did we have reserved instance overlap across regions? We did a temporary scale-up in eu-west1 for model training last month. Could cross-region allocation cause double-applies?
Diego (Infra): Possible. Also, we switched some reservations from regional to zonal in Nov — provider sometimes emits adjustment rows when migrating reservations.
Maya (CloudOps): I'll run the BigQuery export query to pull the raw export and group by invoice/sku/label. Running now.
Maya (CloudOps): SQL I ran: 
```sql
SELECT invoice.id, sku.description, location.region, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as rows
FROM `billing.gcp_export_v1.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice.id = 'INV-2024-12' AND project.id = 'redwood-prod-usw'
GROUP BY invoice.id, sku.description, location.region
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
```
Maya (CloudOps): Result: two top rows are COMPUTE-GPU-RESERVED (12,000) and INTERLEAVED_RESERVED_ADJ (11,980) both in us-west1.
Ava (FinOps): So export confirms duplication at least on our export side.
Diego (Infra): Can we correlate to consumption? Query usage hours by sku + resource name.
Maya (CloudOps): Running that too: 
```sql
SELECT usage_start_time, usage_end_time, resource.name, sku.description, SUM(usage.amount) as hours
FROM `billing.gcp_export_v1.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice.id='INV-2024-12' AND sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
AND project.id='redwood-prod-usw'
GROUP BY usage_start_time, usage_end_time, resource.name, sku.description
ORDER BY hours DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Maya (CloudOps): Consumption shows reserved hours were used and matched expected. There's no extra runtime that would explain an additional 11k charge.
Sam (EngOps): So it's likely a billing adjustment line rather than real extra usage. Could be provider credit paired with a charge but only one side applied.
Ava (FinOps): I opened a support case with Google: CASE-2025-01234. They replied saying an internal migration produced an interleaved adjustment and they would issue a credit if it was a duplicate.
